policy.core_profile: Original MIT code and templates, public-domain IPIP items, and restored legacy questionnaire adaptations under their separate source terms. Availability is not a grant of redistribution rights.
policy.conditional_packs: Require instrument-specific terms, attribution, modification notices and evidence that the actual intended use is covered.
policy.deployment: Evaluate the production use separately from whether a pack may be distributed for another purpose. Free access alone does not establish noncommercial use.
policy.code_separation: Original engine code is separate from question text, copied keys and source documentation; embedding instrument text in JavaScript does not make that text MIT.
policy.history: Capture existing artifacts locally; public historical distributions remain subject to their own rights review.
policy.permissions: A permission to administer may not grant modification, public repository hosting, redistribution or downstream commercial reuse. Record exact scope; never infer sublicensing rights. Operational availability does not certify or expand these rights.
